caption: The drawing depicts a wooden bench with three distinct sections separated by vertical wooden slats. The bench features a straight backrest made up of three horizontal wooden rails with an additional wider rail at the top, and the center of the backrest is divided into three panels by vertical uprights. Each end of the bench has an armrest that curves outward and downward, connecting to the front legs, which are turned and rounded with decorative details. The seat is flat and appears to have a woven or textured pattern, suggesting a different material or weaving technique compared to the wooden frame. The legs of the bench are turned and connected at the bottom by horizontal stretchers that add stability, and there are additional diagonal and vertical supports beneath the seat. The wood is depicted in shades of brown, with a polished finish that highlights the grain and texture. The background is a plain off-white or beige color, with no other objects present, giving the bench full prominence within the composition.
title: Settee
